rows.english: How MetaTrader Demo Accounts Work
rows.translation: MetaTrader 模擬賬戶如何運作

rows.english: A demo account is a practice account. A broker gives it to you. It uses virtual money. You can explore the platform and watch prices. You do not use your own cash.
rows.translation: 模擬帳戶是用於練習的帳戶，由經紀商提供。它使用虛擬資金。您可以探索平台並觀察價格，而無需使用自己的真實資金。

rows.english: Demo accounts let you learn at your own speed. You can open charts and read bid and ask prices. You can open and close practice trades. This makes forex terms easier to grasp.
rows.translation: 模擬帳戶讓您可以按照自己的速度學習。您可以開啟圖表並閱讀買入價和賣出價。您可以開倉和平倉練習交易。這使得外匯術語更容易掌握。

rows.english: MT4 is known for forex. It has charts, indicators and order types. It also runs auto trading with Expert Advisors. The layout is simple. That suits many beginners who want the basics.
rows.translation: MT4 以外匯聞名。它有圖表、指標和訂單型別。它還使用 Expert Advisor 執行自動交易。佈局很簡單。這適合許多想要基礎知識的初學者。

rows.english: People exploring forex Singapore educational resources should compare the two versions according to their requirements rather than assuming that one will automatically produce better trading results. Beginners may benefit from learning one platform thoroughly before experimenting with additional tools.
rows.translation: 探索新加坡外匯交易教育資源的人應根據自己的需求比較這兩個版本，而不是假設其中一個會自動產生更好的交易結果。初學者在嘗試額外工具之前，先徹底掌握一個平台可能會有所幫助。

rows.english: Demos are great for learning. But they miss parts of live trading. Practice orders may run in a different way. The account may not show real liquidity or slippage. It may not show the full effect of the market.
rows.translation: 演示非常適合學習。但他們錯過了部分實時交易。練習訂單可能會以不同的方式執行。該賬戶可能不顯示真實的流動性或滑點。它可能無法顯示市場的全部影響。

rows.english: Yes. A demo account lets you study charts and place practice trades. You can test indicators and learn risk control. You do not need to deposit. But demo results can differ from live trading. Order speed and feelings play a role.
rows.translation: 是的。模擬賬戶可讓您研究圖表並進行練習交易。您可以測試指標並學習風險控制。您無需存款。但演示結果可能與實時交易不同。訂單速度和感受發揮了作用。

rows.english: Set practice stop-loss and take-profit orders. Work out position sizes. Learn how leverage works. Test your rules in different markets. These steps show you the risks before you go live.
